json_schema.description: The parts of a data contract that need judgement: what a row is, and why.

column_notes.description: Optional one-line descriptions of non-obvious output columns, by name.
column_notes.title: Column Notes

grain.description: What one row of the output represents, in one sentence.
grain.title: Grain

keys.description: The output's business key: the smallest set of columns that identifies a row. Choose from the candidate keys listed in the prompt.
keys.title: Keys

partition_columns.description: At most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by, e.g. lob_code; may be empty.
partition_columns.title: Partition Columns

json_schema.title: ContractAnswer

request.system_prompt: You are the contract agent of LANSH, a factory that migrates legacy jobs to PySpark and proves every output matches the legacy output record for record. For one output table, say what one row represents (the grain), choose its business key from the candidate keys you are given (prefer a meaningful business key to a generated one), and name at most two low-cardinality columns worth counting rows by. Comparison policies are not yours to choose.

column_notes.as_of_date: Reporting date from the scheduler parameter &as_of. It is the same on every row.
column_notes.earned_eur: Sum of earned premium over all transactions of the policies in this band.
column_notes.lob_code: Line of business taken from the policy's opening transaction (the first one in load order, kept by PROC SORT NODUPKEY with EQUALS). It is not taken from each transaction.
column_notes.n_policies: Number of distinct policies whose opening transaction falls in this lob_code and band.
column_notes.n_transactions: Number of transactions with a non-missing written_eur, across all transactions of the policies in this band.
column_notes.prem_band: Band set by the premband format on the opening transaction's written_eur. Values are NEGATIVE, 0-249, 250-499, 500-999, 1000+ or UNKNOWN (missing premium). The PySpark version must keep the original load order to pick the opening transaction.
column_notes.written_eur: Sum of written premium over all transactions of the policies in this band.

structured_output.grain: One row per line of business and premium band. Each policy is put in one band, based on the written premium of its first transaction in load order, and all of that policy's transactions are summed in that band.
